prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Pasadena, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported concussion. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1306; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling in the left-hand lane of a multi-lane roadway in Pasadena, Texas, when the vehicle moved into the adjacent lane and made contact with the side of a vehicle operated by Driver 2. Driver 1 reported a concussion and was evaluated at the scene. Responding officers confirmed that a Passenger was also present in Driver 1's vehicle at the time of the collision. Statements from two independent witnesses, the photographs taken at the scene, and Driver 2's account all agree with the sequence of events Driver 1 described. The damage visible on both vehicles, including scraping and displaced panels along the right side of Driver 1's vehicle and the matching marks on Driver 2's left side, is consistent with a sideswipe impact of this kind. Driver 1 told the officer there was no prior damage to the vehicle, and no earlier damage was observed or recorded during the investigation. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy covering the vehicle. The reported head injury is consistent with the forces expected in a collision of this type. Officers issued no citations at the scene pending review of the collected evidence.
